title: SourceDocument
description: One row per candidate file the scraper has seen, accepted or rejected. Persisted regardless of outcome (POLARIS v5.0 SIPOC A2/A3: every candidate must be traceable, not just accepted ones).

raw_uri.description: Where the immutable original bytes live (local path or object storage URI). Never mutated after write.

topic_candidate.description: e.g. GFT. Candidate, not authoritative, until G0 acceptance.

robots_allowed.description: Result of the robots.txt check at retrieval time. Null only if robots.txt could not be fetched.

acceptance_reason.description: Always populated on accept OR reject. This is the field the BUAS audit found missing (F4/A3) -- a keyword match is not by itself an acceptance reason.

requires_ocr.description: True if pdf_segmenter.detect_text_extractability flagged this as likely scanned/image-only. Never silently dropped as 'no text' -- see WP1 framework C6.7. No OCR call is made by this repo; a flagged document is registered with accepted=false and this flag set, for routing to a human or a future OCR step (e.g. the 'Document-intelligence / OCR service' row in the ProtoFocus AI Model Architecture document -- not wired up here).
